title: Junior Design Verification Engineer
description: VLSI/ASIC Verification Engineer working on advanced SoCs for data center CPUs and AI applications. Responsibilities include creating and maintaining SystemVerilog UVM verification environments, developing verification plans, writing tests, debugging failures, functional and code coverage, and working with design and architecture teams. Requirements include a B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, basic SystemVerilog and UVM knowledge, Python or Perl and C programming. RTL, SoC-level verification and coverage-driven verification are advantages.

title: Junior Verification Engineer
description: Junior or mid-level Design Verification role involving digital and analog design, DSP pipelines and firmware-hardware co-verification. Work includes constrained-random and coverage-driven verification of high-speed SerDes IP, DSP datapath validation and hardware-software joint verification. Requirements include a Bachelor's degree in EE, CE or CS, knowledge of digital design and computer architecture, and 0-3 years of industry or academic experience. SystemVerilog/UVM and Python are advantages.
required_degree: Bachelor's degree in EE, CE or CS

title: Junior SOC Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
description: Junior SoC Design Verification Engineer responsible for verifying digital systems and RTL using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for FPGA or ASIC. Responsibilities include verification planning, constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM, SystemVerilog Assertions, coverage, debugging and verification closure.
required_degree: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field

title: Junior CPU Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
description: CPU Design Verification Engineer working on digital designs and verification components. The role includes RTL verification using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for FPGA or ASIC, constrained-random verification, SystemVerilog Assertions, coverage and debugging. UVM, Python, Perl, Shell and CPU or SoC experience are preferred.
required_degree: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field

title: Verification Engineer
description: Verification Engineer for complex modules at block and system level. Responsibilities include defining and executing verification plans, developing SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments, analyzing engineering specifications and writing tests, and working with development teams and architects. ASIC or FPGA verification experience is an advantage.
required_degree: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related field

title: Design Verification Engineer
description: Chip Design Verification Engineer working in a verification team. The role includes building complex verification environments and using advanced verification tools and methodologies. Requirements include a B.Sc. in Electronic Engineering or Computer Engineering, GPA 85+, and 0-3 years of Design Verification experience. Knowledge of Specman or SystemVerilog is an advantage.
required_degree: B.Sc. in Electronic Engineering or Computer Engineering

title: Junior Verification Engineer
description: Junior VLSI verification role for 5G products. Responsibilities include pre-silicon verification of IP in SoC, test plan and constraints definition, SystemVerilog testbench development under UVM, functional coverage and code coverage analysis. Minimum qualifications include a B.Sc. in EE or Computer Science and 1-2 years of hardware verification experience.
required_degree: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science

title: Senior Design Verification Engineer
description: Senior Verification Engineer responsible for developing a complex SoC chip for AI compute. Responsibilities include defining verification strategy, writing and executing verification plans using SystemVerilog UVM, and pre-silicon verification at functional-unit, cluster and full-chip levels. Requirements include 5+ years of verification experience and knowledge of SoC architecture, CPU subsystems and packet-processing technologies.
required_degree: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical or Computer Engineering

title: Verification Engineer
description: Verification Engineer responsible for building and maintaining SystemVerilog/UVM environments, writing testbenches, simulations and regressions, creating verification plans, debugging failures, tracking functional and code coverage and supporting automation. Requirements include a B.Sc. in EE/CE and 3+ years of ASIC/SoC verification experience.
required_degree: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
